updates.title: CVE-2026-50481 Azure Active Directory Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An attacker with existing authorization can modify assumed-immutable data in Azure Active Directory to escalate privileges within the directory. This vulnerability requires existing access but could allow an authenticated user to gain higher-level permissions than intended.

updates.title: CVE-2026-59115 Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A path traversal flaw in Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service (SyncFabric) allows an authorized attacker to escalate privileges on the network. Admins should review and patch this component to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation in identity provisioning workflows.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62869 Azure Entra ID Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: Insufficient verification of data authenticity in Azure Entra ID allows authorized attackers to perform spoofing attacks over the network. This could enable attackers to impersonate legitimate identities or services within your tenant.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention Extends to Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: DLP and auto-labeling capabilities now protect sensitive data flowing through Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex. This expansion lets admins enforce consistent data protection policies across hybrid cloud environments without siloing compliance controls.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Prevents Sensitive Data Exfiltration via Copilot Web Search
updates.summary: DLP policies now block Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive data in external web searches. This prevents unintended leakage of classified information when users interact with AI assistants.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot Extended to Government Clouds
updates.summary: DLP safeguards for Copilot prompts now cover government cloud deployments, blocking responses when sensitive data is detected in user inputs. This ensures parity in compliance controls across sovereign cloud environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Auto-Labeling Capacity Increases to 500,000 Files per Day
updates.summary: SharePoint and OneDrive auto-labeling limits now support 500,000 files per tenant daily, up from 100,000. This acceleration helps organizations close labeling gaps faster and prepare data estates for Copilot with greater coverage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Introduces Guided Diagnostics for Policy Troubleshooting
updates.summary: A new diagnostic experience helps admins understand why DLP policies trigger, showing which rules matched, evaluation order, and condition details; E5 customers also get Copilot-powered recommendations. This reduces time-to-resolution for policy issues and helps admins optimize their DLP configurations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP Device Health Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new dashboard lets admins monitor device health status across all endpoints to verify readiness for policy updates and quickly spot unhealthy devices. This visibility improves the reliability of endpoint DLP deployments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scope Lifecycle-State Evaluation Control
updates.summary: Adaptive Scopes now give admins explicit control over whether recipient and site owner lifecycle status (such as active vs. offboarded) affects scope membership. This ensures policy targeting stays aligned with actual organizational structure changes.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management Archive Support for SharePoint Retention
updates.summary: Admins can now include file archiving as an action within SharePoint data retention policies, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while keeping it discoverable. This extends retention policy capabilities beyond keep/delete to reduce storage costs.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: A new per-policy coverage report shows how files processed during auto-labeling enforcement align with simulation snapshots, helping admins track which files were labeled versus pending and identify enforcement drift. This visibility improves confidence in labeling rollout progress.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: Out-of-box dashboards now track MTTA, MTTD, and MTTR metrics for DLP alerts with customizable SLAs by severity level. This lets admins monitor operational performance and trending sensitive information types, improving security operations efficiency.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Auto-Resolution and Tagging Rules for Alerts
updates.summary: Admins can create rules to automatically resolve predictable alerts and auto-tag others for routing, reducing noise in the DLP triage queue. This rule-based approach helps teams focus on genuine incidents while automating responses to expected alert patterns.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP Integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Entra Global Secure Access to inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, blocking sensitive data from reaching untrusted cloud apps, generative AI platforms, and social media. This network-layer control complements app-level policies and closes enforcement gaps.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: A consolidated alerts page combines classic and agent-triaged alerts into a single view with inline preview of agent summaries and user/alert details. This unification streamlines triage workflows for insider risk investigators.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management Expands User Profile Signals from Entra
updates.summary: User profiles in the unified alert experience now include Entra-sourced signals such as office location, employee type, department, and last working date. This contextual enrichment helps investigators assess user behavior against organizational status more quickly.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management Expands Note Capabilities Across Alerts and Cases
updates.summary: Analysts can now add and view notes on both alerts and cases with automatic system-generated notes on status/assignment changes. This audit trail improves investigation documentation and case tracking.
